business_problem: We wanted a set of platforms that could be used from a producer and consumer perspective to make sure supply and demand of data were meeting each other.
solution_summary: Rabobank built this solution on Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, Power BI. We wanted a set of platforms that could be used from a producer and consumer perspective to make sure supply and demand of data were meeting each other. Azure Data Factory moves and orchestrates data from source systems into the analytics platform. Azure Databricks processes, transforms, and engineers large data sets for analytics and machine learning. Azure Synapse Analytics models and analyzes enterprise data for reporting, AI, and decision support. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics to business users. Once Azure was confirmed for GDP, Rabobank gradually started to move data to the cloud, and used small successes as leverage to greenlight the ongoing migration of data to the cloud. The data exchange platform is supported by tools such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Gen 2, Azure Synapse Analytics, and Azure Databricks.

data_flow: Operational data is ingested through Azure Data Factory from line-of-business systems, engineered and transformed in Azure Databricks before Power BI dashboards surface insights to business users.
business_outcome: Moving forward, Rabobank hopes to expand the usage and accessibility of the data platform, as well as evolve reporting capabilities. As data standards evolve every year, the team will also work to meet those standards and keep data quality at the highest level possible. The data team is looking to implement Azure Purview as part of their platform to help gain more insights and control over data.
metrics: The organization serves nearly 40 different countries and over 9 million customers in the Netherlands.
